x: With sprinter David Rees, John and Bob Hamilton over the 'half' and 'quarter' and new members Michael and Trevor Day and John Crockford over the longer distances, we have the makings of a first class Youth team.
Only 17 seconds behind was John Crockford who had run a stormer for the 'B' team. Mick Day took our first team up a couple of places with a good time of 12.37 but this was as high as we could manage.
Bill Curtin was well up with the chasing group and it was pleasing to see the close support he was getting from Mick Day and John Crockford.
We have over a dozen regular members now, the Hamilton and Day twins forming the nucleus with John Crockford and Nigel Bacon making our first six.
Cliff Calderwood was well up again and when John Crockford led in a solid pack of Bels in 10th place there was no doubt who the winners were.
L.to R: John Crockford, Mick Harvey(12), Ian Gillings(9), Vic Butcher(10), Richard Langley(7),Michael Kane(3),Bill Keohane(rear),Martin Bloice(6) Reg Hopkins(2), Eddie McNally.

Meanwhile, John Crockford is not exactly standing still and Bill and Mick will not beable to afford to slacken off. All boys and youths are asked to let me have details of their school results as they occur.
